Title: Work Items hub and VM-based Azure DevOps Project – VSTS Sprint 131 Update

Body.Content:
In the Sprint 131 Update of Visual Studio Team Services, a few features have received a large amount of feedback and activity on UserVoice. One is the Work Items hub, which now becomes generally available to bring important work to the forefront of your daily workflow. We also added virtual machine as an option for configuring Azure DevOps Projects because we know that retaining lower-level control over web applications is important for some.

Other highlights include:

  • Query work across the iteration schedule with +/- @CurrentIteration
  • Improve release times by partially downloading artifacts

View the full release notes on Microsoft Docs.
